description: This Java class handles database migration tasks for the F-Droid app, including migrating repositories and ignored updates from an old database schema.

classes.name: ContentProviderMigrator
classes.description: A utility class for migrating legacy database data to a new schema within the F-Droid app.

classes.name: ContentProviderDbHelper
classes.description: A helper class extending SQLiteOpenHelper for managing the legacy database schema during migration.

methods.name: needsMigration
methods.description: Checks if the legacy database 'fdroid' exists in the app's database list, indicating a migration is needed.

methods.name: runMigrations
methods.description: Performs migration of repositories and ignored updates from the old database to the new schema.

methods.name: migrateOldRepos
methods.description: Migrates repository data from the old database to the new database, updating repository settings.

methods.name: migrateIgnoredUpdates
methods.description: Migrates ignored update preferences from the old database to the new database.

methods.name: removeOldDb
methods.description: Deletes the legacy database after migration.
